claim: Commercial EUV lithography uses radiation around 13.5 nm.
ASML and ZEISS publicly state that EUV light is absorbed even by air, so the EUV optical light path operates in vacuum and uses reflective optics rather than conventional transmissive lenses.

sources.name: ASML EUV lithography systems - vacuum chamber
ZEISS - Light of the future: EUV lithography

claim: High-NA EUV raises numerical aperture from 0.33 to 0.55.
ZEISS reports that the High-NA illumination system contains more than 25,000 parts and weighs over six tons.
ZEISS reports more than 40,000 parts in High-NA projection optics, weighing around twelve tons.
ASML describes High-NA EXE anamorphic optics as demagnifying the reticle pattern 4x in one direction and 8x in the other, resulting in an exposure field half the size of NXE.

sources.name: ASML - 5 things you should know about High NA EUV lithography

claim: TSMC N7+ was its first EUV process to enter volume production, beginning volume production in 2019.
TSMC states N6 uses additional EUV layers and has been in volume production since 2020.
Samsung announced on October 18, 2018 that it had started wafer production of its 7LPP process using EUV lithography, with initial production at its S3 Fab in Hwaseong, Korea.

sources.name: Samsung Electronics Starts Production of EUV-based 7nm LPP Process

claim: Samsung announced in February 2020 that its V1 line in Hwaseong had begun mass production and was Samsung's first semiconductor production line dedicated to EUV lithography, producing at 7 nm and below.

sources.name: Samsung Electronics Begins Mass Production at New EUV Manufacturing Line

claim: Intel reported in April 2024 that installation of its ASML High-NA EUV tool at D1X in Hillsboro was complete and calibration had started; Intel described the 165-ton system as the industry's first commercial High-NA EUV lithography system.

sources.name: Intel Press Kit: High NA EUV at Intel

claim: Micron states that its 1-gamma DRAM technology uses EUV lithography and describes 1-gamma as its first DRAM node to use EUV in production.
SK hynix announced in July 2021 that it had started mass production of 1anm 8Gb LPDDR4 DRAM using EUV equipment, its first EUV adoption for mass production after partial use in 1ynm DRAM production.

sources.name: SK hynix Starts Mass Production of 1anm DRAM Using EUV Equipment

claim: Rapidus states that an ASML TWINSCAN NXE:3800E was installed at IIM-1 in December 2024 and that installation was completed by April 1, 2025 before full-auto EUV pattern exposure and development milestones.
TSMC reported in 2020 that its dry-clean technique for EUV masks reduced fall-on particles by more than 99%, while replacing a traditional wet-clean step for the reported use case.

sources.name: TSMC Develops the World's First Dry-Clean Technique for EUV Mask

claim: imec reported in 2020 that full-field CNT-based pellicles were mounted on reticles and exposed in an NXE:3300 EUV scanner, with tested single-pass EUV transmission up to 97%.

sources.name: imec demonstrates CNT pellicle utilization on EUV scanner

claim: ZEISS states that AIMS systems are used for photomask qualification and that the AIMS EUV generation can inspect EUV masks.

sources.name: ZEISS - 30 Years of AIMS, the industry standard for mask qualification

claim: A published ASML patent application describes an EUV reticle stage supporting a reflective reticle with configurable shielding elements.
A published ASML patent application describes a lithographic apparatus with an illuminator, reflective patterning device, substrate table and reflective projection system for EUV use.

sources.name: US20250328068A1 - Reflective member for EUV lithography

claim: A published ASML patent application discusses contamination from plasma target material in an EUV light source and mitigation around collection optics.
Published ASML patents describe EUV target droplets and droplet-acceleration concepts within an EUV radiation source.

sources.name: US8598551B2 - EUV radiation source comprising a droplet accelerator
US20230164900A1 - Accelerating droplets in a droplet generator

claim: A published EUV collector-mirror patent describes a reflecting surface and a pump-light grating concept associated with source/collector operation.
A published ASML patent family describes a membrane for EUV lithography associated with the mask/reticle environment.

sources.name: WO2017186486A1 - A membrane for EUV lithography

claim: Public academic literature studies periodic Mo/Si multilayer mirrors for EUV wavelengths and shows that layer/interface properties materially influence optical performance.

sources.name: Structure of periodic Mo/Si multilayers for EUV lithography

claim: A public refined EUV mask model represents the reflective stack with Mo/Si multilayers, a protective layer and an absorber stack for electromagnetic simulation.
OpenEUV groups the scanner into source, illumination, reticle, projection, wafer stage, metrology and vacuum domains for educational navigation.
rationale: This is an educational taxonomy inferred by combining recurring subsystem boundaries across first-party descriptions and public patent diagrams; it is not an ASML product BOM or service decomposition.
